payload.name: description
payload.value:
When I instruct the agent to do a task, I want that prompt to authorize the task without another harness approval hierarchy or mandatory budgeting questions, so I can complete work without repeated artificial consent.

## Owner Request

Owner directive 2026-10-24: remove L1/L2/L3 levels and budgeting questions. The task prompt is the approval. File this improvement at high priority and add it to the combined list; do not start its implementation yet.

## Evidence

Starting basicly-hp06epo required a separate request for scoped L3 autonomy and a 300000-token ceiling after the owner had already said do 1. The policy then required a one-time grant confirmation before the loop could proceed. These questions came from the harness, not from a demonstrated host permission denial.

## Execution Order

Next after completing basicly-hp06epo. This supersedes the previous combined order. Work on one story at a time.

## Confirmation Plan

Exercise an isolated user-requested workflow without any grant, budget or confirm code. Check normal intake, optional planning fields, supervisor admission, failed-gate refusal, explicit budget enforcement, destructive-action protections, legacy record readability and concurrent tracker merges. Verify generated instruction contracts. Full verification runs before integration.

## Related Work

Coordinate with basicly-l5pvyjj for retained safety approvals and scope freeze, basicly-s0snzge for resumable transitions, and basicly-0m4thm1 for optional cost reporting. Existing budget/approval followups need scope review when this task starts; do not implement them now.

payload.text: Owner said next, authorizing implementation of this story. Their directive explicitly makes the task prompt the approval and removes mandatory grant/budget questions. Bootstrap uses native isolated worktree and verified merge commands without issuing a replacement grant; readiness, confirmation, verification and protected-action rules remain enforced. Main owns engine integration; a bounded specialist may update guidance in its own worktree.
